  I can take either approach here, but they have different trade-offs and I
  would rather not guess.

╭─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Which caching strategy should I use?                                        │
│                                                                             │
│ ❯ 1. Write-through — simpler, slower writes                                 │
│   2. Write-back — faster, risks losing data on crash                        │
│   3. No cache for now                                                       │
╰─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
